text.description_html:
Schlage B660P Single Cylinder Grade 1 Commercial Deadbolt Thick Door Extension Kit

This extension kit allows single cylinder deadbolt to be used on 2" - 4" thick doors and gates that are extended equally. For use with Schlage B660P Deadbolts.

Kit includes extra long tail piece and screws.

*Sold Individually
